verdicts.explanation: The introduction states that LSTZ0.75 achieved σb of 3.5 × 10-4 S/cm at room temperature, with the citation [16] attached to the sentence, so the value is literature_cited, bulk, and the null temperature in C is acceptable because only 'room temperature' is given.

The paper gives an apparent σgb of 1.2 × 10-3 S/cm (including the grain size effect) for LSTZ0.75 in the same cited sentence about ref. 16, so the grain-boundary kind, unit, and literature_cited origin are correct.
The introduction gives σt of 2.7 × 10-4 S/cm at room temperature for LSTZ0.75 with the citation [16] attached, so the total-conductivity value and literature_cited origin are correct.

Section 2.1 reports the highest experimental σb of 4.1 × 10-4 S/cm at 25 ℃ and Ea of 0.33 eV from 25 to 140 ℃ for a hot-pressed LSTZ0.75 sample, attributed to ref. 37, so the origin is literature_cited and the hot-pressing method, temperature, and Ea are stated; sintering and density fields are correctly null.
